limitations.note: The patch changed the already-correct 9-cycle branch to a six-tick high pulse and left the faulty 8-cycle branch unchanged; the fix was to change `div_e>>1` to `div_e>>2`.
The test assumed six high ticks in both modes, so it accepted the wrong waveform even though the correct output is high for four ticks in each mode and has the same rising-edge count.
